##### Project general facts

J One Tower A by RKM Durar Properties is part of a striking sculptural landmark whose name comes from the Emirati heritage word for the finest quality pearl, with the whole design conceptualised from pearls, shells and the waves of the sea. The two towers are linked by six signature townhouses and an impressive open plaza that forms the ultimate spot for catching up with friends, giving the development a real sense of community. Every residence is wrapped in floor-to-ceiling glazing that frames stunning views and draws optimal natural light deep into the living spaces, making this tower a genuine work of art to come home to.

Residents enjoy unmatched five-star facilities, including two health clubs with beautifully equipped gyms designed to restore body and mind in a luxurious setting. There are four swimming pools across the development, among them tranquil rooftop pools that make a peaceful sanctuary for relieving the stresses of the day, plus four steam rooms and four saunas for complete relaxation. A VIP lounge for private celebrations, serene sky gardens, an open plaza with signature sculptures and beautiful landscaping, and full concierge service with optional in-house cleaning, food delivery, dry cleaning and bellboy assistance make daily life effortless.

The interiors are the epitome of highly stylised ultra-modern design, combining international style with the local traditions of diving and pearl hunting to create an atmosphere of understated elegance. Designer furniture and high-end materials bring the spaces to life, from rich timbers and natural stone to fine fabrics, customised carpets, special glass, stainless steel detailing and beautifully high-finished ceilings. The kitchens pair warm walnut cabinetry with natural stone countertops, integrated ovens and a generous breakfast island, while the bathrooms feature marble surfaces, mosaic detailing and elegant double vanities that complete a truly turnkey home.

##### Location description and benefits

Downtown Dubai is the centre of Dubai, constantly evolving at a fast pace. Home to many landmarks and world-famous attractions, including Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Mall and Dancing Fountains, the area is a hub of activities.

The prime location keeps Downtown busy throughout the year. Constantly attracting tourists, there’re always some new things to do in Downtown Dubai. The area is best known for offering a luxurious lifestyle. It used to be a vertical community, but many villas have also been added to the real estate market. As per Bayut’s 2020 Rental Market Report, it is the second most popular area offering luxury apartments for rent after Dubai Marina. Downtown is well connected to other key commercial and residential areas in the city.

Strategically located along Sheikh Zayed Road, E11, across Al Wasl and bordering Business Bay, it is a pretty active and bustling neighbourhood. Downtown is one of Dubai’s best areas for non-drivers and frequent travellers. Many amenities, including upscale hotels, chic leisure points and massive shopping centres, make Downtown Dubai a sought-after address and “the centre of now.”
